proposal.reason: Main change adds host one-sided RMA (PutSignal/Signal/WaitSignal) as new runtime operations wired through enqueue planning/group launch and task scheduling. Copy-engine review is needed for the new CE execution backend (RMA CE init/finalize, batched mem ops, graph/eager signal-ack synchronization, chunked put). Device-api review is needed for substantive symmetric window/LSA runtime semantics and capability gating updates (window offset consistency checks, hostRmaSupport exposure, and related communicator/window validation behavior).
